annotations.title: Check an NPI against the LEIE

description: Validates a 10-digit National Provider Identifier (check digit) and looks it up in the NPI field of the LEIE mirror. Returns the excluded record(s) that carry it, or a not-on-list result. Most LEIE records have no NPI, so a not-on-list result does not show that a provider is not excluded.

detail.description: "full" adds UPIN and the exclusion kind and minimum period.
